flows.name: Browse weekly produce
flows.goal: Find produce available for the coming week.
alternates: If no produce is available, show an empty availability list and allow the buyer to return later.
acceptance: The buyer can browse produce available for the coming week.
The buyer can open a listing and review its produce, available quantity, and price.

flows.name: Order and pay
flows.goal: Select produce, place a bulk order for a delivery day, and pay online.

steps.action: confirm quantities, delivery day, and delivery fee

alternates: If payment fails, show the failed outcome and allow another payment attempt.
The buyer can leave before confirming the order and return to produce selection.
acceptance: The buyer can confirm produce quantities and a requested delivery day before placing a bulk order.
The order total includes the delivery fee and is shown before online payment.
The buyer receives a clear payment outcome, including when payment needs another attempt.

flows.name: Manage business purchase
flows.goal: Order produce and pay using the restaurant or shop account.
alternates: If payment fails, make the outcome clear and allow another attempt.
The owner can return to the business order list without placing an order.
acceptance: The owner can place an order using the business account and review its progress.
The order total includes the delivery fee before the owner pays online.
The payment outcome and resulting order status are visible to the business account.

provenance.quote: Farmers list their produce with quantity and price and see their orders
List produce and set quantity and price

flows.name: List produce
flows.goal: Create a produce listing with quantity and price and review incoming orders.

steps.action: create a listing after seller approval

alternates: If the farmer is not approved, show that listing access is unavailable and direct them to await the marketplace check.
acceptance: A farmer approved by the marketplace manager can create and manage produce listings.
A farmer can set the produce, available quantity, and price on a listing.
An unapproved farmer cannot create a listing until the manager check is complete.

flows.name: Manage FPO produce
flows.goal: Manage listings on behalf of an FPO and see its orders.

steps.action: create a listing after seller approval

alternates: If the FPO has not been approved, show that listing access is unavailable pending the marketplace check.
acceptance: An FPO coordinator can manage listings on behalf of the FPO after it has been approved by the marketplace manager.
The coordinator can create and update produce listings with quantity and price.
An unapproved FPO cannot create listings until its manager check is complete.

flows.name: Deliver an order
flows.goal: Receive an order for local delivery and update its simple delivery status.
alternates: If a delivery cannot be completed, the partner can mark it unable to deliver so the manager can follow up.
If no delivery is assigned, the partner sees an empty assignment list.
acceptance: The transport partner can see assigned deliveries and the information needed for pickup and drop-off.
The assigned partner can update a delivery's simple status.
The updated status is visible to the relevant buyer and seller.

flows.name: Oversee marketplace
flows.goal: Check farmer and FPO eligibility, spot-check listings, and oversee orders and delivery arrangements.

steps.action: assign delivery to a transport partner

alternates: If seller information is insufficient, leave the review pending and add notes for follow-up.
If there are no pending reviews or orders, show an empty state and allow the manager to return to the overview.
acceptance: The manager can find farmers and FPOs requiring eligibility checks and record an eligibility decision for each.
A seller's review status and notes are available for oversight, and only sellers approved through review are eligible to list.
The manager can inspect marketplace orders and their fulfillment statuses.
